## How to Use This Site

- **Find an SOP:** Use the sidebar navigation or the search bar (top right).
- **Download a PDF:** Visit the [PDF downloads](pdfs/index.md) page.
- **Suggest a change:** Click the "Edit this page" link on any SOP, or
  [open an issue](https://github.com/YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME/lab-sops/issues/new).
- **Create a new SOP:** Copy `sops/_SOP-TEMPLATE.qmd`, fill it in, and
  submit a Pull Request.
